visualCharacteristics.purpose: Icon + heading + short text tiles presented as a row of equal feature highlights
visualCharacteristics.description: Repeating structure of three identical icon + heading + text tiles laid out side by side.

contentPattern.structure: Repeating rows, one per tile: cell 1 = small icon image; cell 2 = heading (H3) and a short paragraph

cells: H3 'Unified context.'; paragraph 'A shared foundation of structured business metadata for alignment.'
H3 'Human & AI collaboration.'; paragraph 'Seamless workflows optimized for speed and efficiency.'
H3 'Brand intelligence.'; paragraph 'A centralized understanding of brand standards and signals to guide creation.'

usage: Use for 3-up (or 2-up) value-proposition highlights where each tile is an icon, a short heading and one sentence. Tiles are not links.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any non-linked icon feature list. Use cards-horizontal instead when each tile is a link, and cards-resource when tiles carry a type label.
